dedupe_keys.name: belize national emergency shelter list 2026 designated hurricane shelters by district and community with shelters suited to people with physical disabilities

description: This list names every building designated as a hurricane shelter in Belize for the 2026 season, published by the National Emergency Management Organization. The 24-page document is arranged by district and by community or neighbourhood, and for each gives the shelters people should go to; many are schools, churches and community centres, and coastal communities and the cayes are paired with inland evacuation shelters in Belmopan, Santa Elena and San Ignacio. An icon marks shelters built to accommodate people with physical disabilities. The list is free to download as a PDF, and the same shelters are shown on a shelter locator map on the NEMO website. Caveats: the list gives names but no coordinates or capacities, it must be geocoded before use, it is replaced each season, and no licence is stated. Coverage is national. Simulation uses: evacuation and shelter-allocation models for Belize, checking shelter exposure to storm surge and flooding, and planning accessible shelter capacity. Related records: the NEMO damage and needs assessment reports (data-nemo-belize-damage-and-needs-assessment-reports) complement the list.
